deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application for admission (domestic and international, most programs)
deadlines.notes: Applications open 1 Oct 2026 and are assessed on a rolling basis; apply early. The program pages for Computing Science, Economics and Engineering list the international deadline as 1 March 2027. Final transcripts and outstanding documents for high school applicants are due 1 Aug 2027. Some programs (Nursing, Dentistry, Medicine, Law) have their own timelines.

deadlines.label: International applications close - Semester 1, 2027
deadlines.notes: Stated as 'Applications are now open and will close on the 15 December 2026' for Semester 1, 2027. Deadlines for programs with additional selection criteria may vary. Acceptance deadline for Semester 1 is 15 January 2027 if overseas, 31 January 2027 if in Australia. Applicants completing the IB Diploma, an Australian Year 12 or the NCEA apply through UAC International instead.

deadlines.label: UCAS equal-consideration deadline (Overseas application deadline)
deadlines.notes: The course pages list 13 January 2027 as both the Home and Overseas application deadline.

deadlines.label: UCAS deadline for September 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Applications close at 18:00 GMT, as printed on the Computer Science, Economics and Mechanical Engineering course pages.

deadlines.label: UCAS equal-consideration deadline (6 pm UK time)
deadlines.notes: Bristol says the final deadline for all international undergraduate applications is 30 June, but some courses fill up and may close on 13 January. Medicine, dentistry and veterinary courses: 15 October 2026.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application for international applicants (closing date)
deadlines.notes: The requirements pages for Computer Science, Economics and Engineering give international application dates for the Fall 2027 intake as 15 Aug 2026 to 1 Apr 2027. The general dates page (https://www.ucalgary.ca/future-students/undergraduate/admissions/dates) separately lists 1 March as the Fall application deadline (application fee and program choices) and 15 March for unofficial transcripts and supporting documents, so aim for 1 March. Most offers are made after first-term Grade 12 transcripts arrive.

deadlines.label: UCAS deadline for 2027 entry to Cambridge
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. All Cambridge courses use the 15 October deadline; Cambridge sets its own admissions assessment (TMUA / ESAT) and interviews.

deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (Durham undergraduate courses)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. UCAS equal consideration date for 2027 entry.

deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (non-Medicine courses)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. UCAS main round.

deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (Medicine MBChB)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. Early UCAS deadline for Medicine.

deadlines.label: UCAS equal-consideration deadline (all courses except Medicine)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. Medicine (BMBS) has an earlier deadline of 15 Oct 2026.

deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (Imperial undergraduate courses)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time, equal-consideration deadline; Imperial's institution code is I50. Applicants must also sit the course's admissions test (TMUA or ESAT).

deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (King's undergraduate courses)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. UCAS equal consideration date for 2027 entry. The King's course pages leave the application deadline field blank, so the UCAS date applies.

deadlines.label: UCAS equal-consideration deadline
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. Leeds course pages for Computer Science and Mechanical Engineering say to check the UCAS deadline and that Leeds may consider later applications.

deadlines.label: Leeds University Business School: deadline for international students (Economics)
deadlines.notes: The Economics BSc page states 'The deadline for international students to apply to Leeds University Business School courses is 30 June' (no year is printed, so 30 June 2027 is assumed).

deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (Loughborough undergraduate courses)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. UCAS equal-consideration date for 2027 entry; applications after it are not guaranteed equal consideration.

deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (LSE undergraduate programmes)
deadlines.notes: As stated on the LSE course pages (13 January 2027); UCAS closes at 18:00 UK time. Economics also requires the TMUA.

deadlines.label: International applications close - Session 1, 2027 (North Ryde)
deadlines.notes: Applications open 1 January 2026; Session 1 starts 22 February 2027. Session 2 applications close 12 July 2027 (starts 26 July 2027). The page says the closing date may vary by location and advises checking with the local representative; applying early is recommended to arrange visa, travel and accommodation. Australian Year 12 students apply through UAC.

deadlines.label: UCAS equal-consideration closing date (6pm GMT)
deadlines.notes: Manchester states this is the closing date for receipt of applications to be given equal consideration. UCAS also gives school or college deadlines that are likely to be earlier.

deadlines.label: McGill application deadline (Fall 2027; Arts, Science, Engineering)
deadlines.notes: Applies to applicants from high schools outside Canada and the U.S. and also to U.S. diploma holders. Supporting documents are due March 1, 2027; the Music and Religious Studies programs have their own listed deadlines.

deadlines.label: Supporting documents deadline
deadlines.notes: For programs without a separate deadline.

deadlines.label: Major Entrance Scholarship application and documents
deadlines.notes: As listed on the same page.

deadlines.label: OUAC application deadline - Engineering and Computer Science
deadlines.notes: Recommended early application date 12 Nov 2026. Applying through OUAC. The Honours Economics I entry lists 1 Apr 2027 as its application deadline.

deadlines.label: Application deadline - Honours Economics I (applicants outside Canada)
deadlines.notes: No supplementary application is listed for this program.

deadlines.label: Engineering and Computer Science: supplementary application due (11:59 p.m. ET)

deadlines.label: Supporting documents (transcripts, English proficiency test) deadline for applicants not at an Ontario high school

deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (Nottingham undergraduate courses)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. UCAS equal-consideration date for 2027 entry; applications after it are not guaranteed equal consideration.

deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (all Oxford courses)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. UCAS main round; this is the early UCAS deadline that applies to every Oxford course, Medicine and Dentistry/Veterinary. Admissions tests are sat in October (TMUA 12-16 Oct 2026 for Computer Science).

deadlines.label: Application deadline: first-year full-time programs except Commerce, Health Sciences and Nursing
deadlines.notes: Applies to Computing, Arts (Economics) and Engineering. Applications open October 1, 2026. Apply through OUAC, Common App or the Queen's International Application portal. Commerce, Health Sciences and Nursing are due February 1, 2027 (not covered here).

deadlines.label: Deadline to submit all documents, including transcripts and English test scores
deadlines.notes: As listed on the deadlines page.

deadlines.label: Major Admission Award (MAA) application on SOLUS
deadlines.notes: Queen's recommends applying to Queen's by November 20 (the page also says November 15 in one line) so the MAA application is accessible.

deadlines.label: SFU Fall 2027 application deadline (high school applicants)
deadlines.notes: Apply on Education Planner BC; applications open 1 Oct 2026. Admission documents are due 28 Feb 2027. Beedie School of Business applicants must complete their to-do list by 7 Feb 2027 (not relevant to the programs listed). Early admission consideration is only for B.C. 12 curriculum students.

deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (Southampton undergraduate courses)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. UCAS equal-consideration date for 2027 entry; applications after it are not guaranteed equal consideration.

deadlines.label: International undergraduate closing date, Semester 1 (February) 2027
deadlines.notes: Page: Semester 1 (Feb) closes 1 December of the year prior to commencement; Semester 2 (Aug) closes 29 May. Applications may close earlier once capacity is reached (check the course page). Students currently in an Australian Year 12 qualification, or an IB diploma in Australia, apply via UAC and follow its dates instead.

deadlines.label: OUAC application deadline (Arts & Science St. George and Applied Science & Engineering)
deadlines.notes: International applicants have the same deadlines as listed. Apply through OUAC. Recommended early application date is 7 Nov 2026 (see below).

deadlines.label: Recommended early application date (apply by 7 Nov, documents by 1 Dec 2026)
deadlines.notes: Applicants who apply by 7 Nov and submit available documents by 1 Dec 2026 are eligible for the first admission round.

deadlines.label: Engineering: Engineering Supplemental Application (ESA) and supporting documents due
deadlines.notes: Mandatory for every Engineering program; the application is not considered without it.

deadlines.label: Arts & Science St. George: supporting documents and Computer Science Supplementary Application due
deadlines.notes: Document deadline for Arts & Science St. George is 1 Feb 2027; the Computer Science Supplementary Application is also due 1 Feb 2027.

deadlines.label: UBC Vancouver final application deadline (Winter Session 2027/28)
deadlines.notes: 11:59 p.m. PST. Applications open early October 2026. English documents are due 15 Feb 2027; US and other non-Canadian high school applicants submit required documents by 15 Mar 2027.

deadlines.label: International Scholars Program award application
deadlines.notes: 11:59 p.m. PST. International applicants must apply to UBC and submit an award application by this date to be considered for the UBC International Scholars Program awards; supporting documents are due 31 Jan 2027. The page lists the International Major Entrance Scholarships and the Outstanding International Student Award only as March to April 2027 announcements and gives no separate application deadline for them.

deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (UCL courses other than Medicine)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. UCAS main round, equal-consideration deadline.

deadlines.label: Final Term 1 2027 completed-application deadline (offshore applicants)
deadlines.notes: Page: offshore applications for Term 1 2027 remain open until 15 November 2026; an outcome is promised by 10 December 2026 but not guaranteed for late applications. Earlier offer rounds close on 14 May, 16 July, 20 August and 24 September 2026 (offers released from August); applying early gives the best chance of a place. Applicants holding an Australian qualification apply through UAC.

deadlines.label: Direct applications to UQ close - Semester 1 2027 intake
deadlines.notes: Page text: 'To commence study in semester 1 - November 30 of the previous year' (semester 2: May 31 of the year of commencement). Same dates on the Computer Science, Economics and Engineering (Honours) pages. International students whose senior schooling is Australian Year 12 (in Australia or elsewhere) or IB in Australia apply through QTAC and should check QTAC's closing date.

deadlines.label: International closing date, Autumn session (February/March 2027 start), applicants outside Australia
deadlines.notes: The UTS page lists 30 November (outside Australia) and 15 January (in Australia) for the Autumn session without printing a year; for the Autumn 2027 intake these fall on 30 Nov 2026 and 15 Jan 2027. Spring (July) closes 30 April (outside Australia).

deadlines.label: International applications for Semester 1 2027 (all other countries)
deadlines.notes: UWA lists 'Apply for Semester 1 by 11 January 2027' for most countries (Semester 2: 7 June 2027). Applicants from a listed group of countries (including Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, Philippines, Sri Lanka, Vietnam) have earlier dates: 28 December 2026 and 24 May 2027. UWA adds that dates may change without notice and some courses have different dates.

deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (Warwick undergraduate courses)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. UCAS equal consideration date for 2027 entry.

deadlines.label: Application deadline - programs other than Engineering (apply through OUAC)
deadlines.notes: International students have the same deadlines. Documents due 15 Feb 2027. The deadline may be extended if a program is not yet full; later applications are reviewed only if spaces are available.

deadlines.label: Application deadline - Engineering programs (other than Architecture)

deadlines.label: Documents deadline and Admission Information Form (Faculty of Mathematics programs incl. Computer Science)
